data.description:
## Summary
On the bootstrapped host project from the preceding task, open a deliberate-violation test PR containing a known security issue, observe that the CI security overlay fires and blocks merge, then clean up all verification artifacts.

## Testing Mode
GREEN — make the E2E verification assertions pass once bootstrap task provides the host project.

## Acceptance Criteria
- GIVEN the bootstrapped project from task 7e4e-2fee
  WHEN a test PR is opened with a deliberate security violation (e.g., hardcoded API key in a tracked file)
  THEN gh pr checks shows the llm-review CI job ran and exited non-zero
- GIVEN the CI job ran with security overlay enabled
  WHEN its logs are inspected
  THEN SECURITY_OVERLAY_TRIGGERED is present in the reviewer-findings output and ci-llm-review-runner.sh ran in fetched-assets mode (marker file confirms)
- GIVEN the CI job exits non-zero
  THEN gh pr merge --auto remains queued and does not execute (merge is blocked)
- GIVEN verification is complete
  THEN test PR is closed, test branch deleted, and $RUNNER_TEMP scratch is removed (cleanup verified)
- If any prerequisite from the bootstrap task was not met (explicit SKIP log present), this task also explicitly skips with a matching log (never silently passes)

## Files to Modify
- tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-verify.sh (new test script)
- .test-index (add mapping: tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-verify.sh [test_host_e2e_security_overlay_blocks_merge])

## Implementation Notes
- Deliberate violation: a file with the string `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-test-hardcoded-1234567890` in a tracked location
- Use `gh pr create --draft` to avoid inadvertent auto-merge triggers
- Poll `gh pr checks` with a timeout (max 10 minutes) for CI job completion
- Cleanup: `gh pr close`, `git push origin --delete <test-branch>`, `rm -rf $RUNNER_TEMP/<project-dir>`
- Load bootstrapped project path from the state file written by task 7e4e-2fee
data.title: Open deliberate-violation test PR on bootstrapped host project and verify security overlay blocks merge
